mappings.description: List of input-to-output mapping rules. Each rule defines how an input event from a device should be transformed.

device_path.description: Absolute path to the input device (e.g., /dev/input/event0). Must exist and be readable by the daemon.

input_type.description: Type of the input event: EV_KEY for buttons/keys, EV_ABS for absolute axes (e.g., joysticks), EV_REL for relative axes (e.g., mouse movement).

input_code.description: Input event code (e.g., 'KEY_A', 'BTN_LEFT', 'ABS_X'). Must match the input device’s event code naming (see linux/input-event-codes.h).

target_type.description: Target event type. Use special values like 'CLEAR', 'IGNORE', 'SYNC', or 'NOP' for control actions instead of remapping.

target_code.description: Target event code (e.g., 'KEY_B', 'BTN_RIGHT', 'ABS_Y') or empty for special targets like 'CLEAR' and 'IGNORE'.
